odc_type: Incorrect logic in composite formatter construction
observation_summary: The parser throws an IllegalArgumentException when attempting to parse valid ISO-8601 period strings that contain separators.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the PeriodFormatterBuilder fails to correctly handle nested separators when constructing a composite formatter. Specifically, when a separator is the first element in a list of elements, the builder attempts to optimize or finish the separator but does so without checking if the separator has already been initialized or if it is part of a valid chain. The fix introduces a conditional check to ensure that the separator's parser and printer are only finished if they are currently null, preventing the incorrect overwriting or malformed construction of the formatter chain that leads to parsing errors for valid ISO-8601 period strings.
